validated_results.title: Associations of intakes of total protein, protein from dairy sources, and dietary calcium with risks of colorectal, breast, and prostate cancer: a prospective analysis in UK Biobank.
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort analysis of UK Biobank evaluating dietary total protein intake and incident prostate cancer risk.

sample_size.excerpt: In total, this left 114,217 participants who completed ≥2 (maximum 5) valid 24-h dietary assessments, of which 51,278 were men and 62,939 were women.

cases.excerpt: Over a median of 9.4 years of follow-up (IQR: 9.3–9.8 years), 1193 incident colorectal cancer, 2024 breast cancer and 2422 prostate cancer cases were observed.
